faqs.question: What skills are needed for Web3 jobs?
faqs.answer: Developers: Solidity, Rust, or TypeScript. Non-technical: community management, marketing, content creation, BD. All positions expect understanding of blockchain fundamentals.

faqs.question: Where to find Web3 jobs?
faqs.answer: Crypto.jobs and Web3.career are dedicated job boards. LinkedIn has a growing number of crypto positions. Hiring posts on Twitter/X are common. Many positions are posted in project Discords.

faqs.question: Are Web3 jobs mostly remote?
faqs.answer: Yes, most Web3 jobs are remote-first. Companies are distributed globally. Timezone flexibility varies - some require overlap with US or European timezones.
